name: Recipe Master
author: zcesl53

sections.description:
Features

An overview of Recipe Master’s features:

  • Securely store all your recipes on your WordPress website
  • Two user types, Head Chefs can define recipes while chefs can view them
  • Sophisticed support for sub-recipes and composite recipes (meals, selection boxes etc)
  • Understand your Cost of Goods and pricing
  • Easily scale recipes
  • Organise your recipes by types and selections
  • Automatic generation of ingredient listings, allergen details and dietary notes
  • Integration into your WordPress website making showing recipes or product details straightforward
  • Daily checklists for your EHO records
  • Secure storage for process documentation, handbooks etc.
  • Price Calculator with support for retailer margins and markups, to show exactly how much profit you will make
  • Chocolate composition calculator to help blend chocolate types
  • Support for additional information on ingredient listings such as E number warnings
  • Developed by a working food business so you know all features are road tested in a real business before being released

WP Recipe Maker Premium

Recipe Master Premium provides enhanced support

This plugin is in active development. Feel free to contact us with any feature requests or ideas.

https://jamesb520.sg-host.com/wiki/getting-started/

1.7.15

  • Improvement: added link to template from reverse search
  • Bug fix: refactoring to address pcp checks and phpstorm checks

  • Improvement: New price update tool to make keeping prices up to date as easy as possible
  • Improvement: New reverse search feature to allow you to find recipes containing an ingredient
  • Improvement: New tools menu to collect tools together
  • Improvement: Support for non 20% VAT Rates
  • Improvement: New mechanism for user defined pages that ensures they work with editors like Elementor
  • Improvement: All premium features moved into base version
  • Improvement: Moved freemium plugin location
  • Bug fix: fix bug when ingredients and activities empty

1.7.9

  • Bug fix: Fix issue where recipes without ingredients lead to error displaying page
  • Bug fix: Fix warnings where ingredients or activities are missing
  • Improvement: Update to freemius version

1.7.8

  • Improvement: Enhanced details displayed on wordPress.org

1.7.7

  • Improvement: Code updates to adhere to wordPress.org standards
